title: First version of the fact dataset
changes: Added Companies House fees for incorporation, confirmation statements and change of name.
Added identity verification dates and routes.
Added company name length rules from the 2015 Names Regulations.
Added published registration prices for Tide and ANNA.

title: Company formation rules added
changes: Added director, shareholder, company secretary and registered office rules from GOV.UK.
Added registered email requirement and registration times (online and by post).

title: Facts for new guides
changes: Added identity verification details: accepted ID, Post Office route, personal codes, ACSPs, PSC deadlines and penalties.
Added confirmation statement, dormant company, change of name and registered office rules.
Added Companies House search facts and the same-day change of name fee (£85, per the fees page; one older GOV.UK guide still shows £83).

title: Facts for VAT, trade mark and domain tools
changes: Added UK VAT number formats, check digits and official checking services.
Added UK trade mark search, fees (from 1 April 2026), timings and renewal.
Added the registration lookup services used by the domain name checker.

title: Business accounts, fees and personal codes
changes: Added business account facts for Tide, ANNA, Starling, Monzo Business, Mettle and Wise Business, from each provider's own pages.
Added the FSCS deposit protection limit of £120,000, in force since 1 December 2025.
Added ANNA's standard company registration price of £19 (free with its paid Enhanced or Total Support plans), replacing the free price shown before.
New pages: Companies House fees, Companies House personal code, and business bank accounts.
